segments.comment: A game whose first level holds the themed "Cloud room": its fill calls des.gas_cloud({ selection = selection.room() }), which reaches lspo_gas_cloud and create_gas_cloud_selection. The hero dismisses the welcome and searches once. Seed chosen by replaying the port over seeds 7400-8399 with this character and no keys and keeping those whose first level held a gas-cloud region: 7639 is the first of six.
